definition: to take part in a rebellion
description: In a big open-plan Japanese office full of identical grey cubicles, a woman in a company uniform climbs up and stands on top of her desk, glaring down at the room while the other workers sit at their screens. One by one the workers stop working: sheets of paper and a necktie fly up into the air as men and women jump to their feet and punch their fists upward. At the end the whole floor is standing between the desks with their arms folded, staring straight ahead at the camera while loose paper lies scattered on the carpet.

en.question: What is the angry woman doing?

de.answer: Sie starrt ihre Kollegen wütend an.
phrases: sich die Krawatte vom Hals reißen
